title: Watercolor Christmas Sticker Collection
author: BundleDesigner
description:
🎄 Welcome to BundleDesigner Studio! 🎄
Enhance your winter holiday projects with this gorgeous Watercolor Christmas Sticker Collection! This bundle features 10 beautifully detailed, hand-drawn style watercolor elements, including a cute gingerbread man, a festive candy cane, shiny golden bells, snowflakes, holly berries, and winter floral elements.
Perfect for creators, crafters, and small business owners, these elements are ready to cut, print, and design instantly!
✨ PERFECT FOR:
• Cricut, Silhouette, and cutting machine crafts (SVG files)
• Sublimation printing (Christmas T-shirts, Coffee Mugs, Tote bags)
• Planner stickers, scrapbooking, and journal layouts
• Holiday gift packaging, boxes, tags, and labels
• Festive greeting cards, DIY invitations, and web design
📦 WHAT’S INCLUDED IN THE ZIP FILE:
• 10 High-resolution individual PNG files (Transparent background, 300 DPI)
• Vector EPS files (Fully scalable, editable, and print-ready)
••• IMPORTANT NOTE:
This artwork was created with the assistance of Generative AI tools and carefully curated, edited, and formatted to ensure the highest professional quality for your crafting needs.
••• COMMERCIAL USE ALLOWED!
Download this ultimate holiday elements pack today and start crafting beautiful designs. Thank you so much for supporting my shop! Happy Crafting! ❤️
